candidate.name: Alex Morgan
candidate.headline: Project Coordinator | Procurement | Client Relations
candidate.summary: Project coordinator with seven years in construction and property. Plans deliveries, follows up suppliers and keeps clients informed from contract to handover. Cut delays with fixed weekly plans and clear deviation routines, and wants to bring this to a growing contractor as coordinator.

target.description: We are looking for a structured project coordinator with construction experience. You will be responsible for schedules, procurement, follow-up of subcontractors, health and safety documentation and client contact. Experience with Excel, Procore and Power BI is an advantage.

experience.title: Project Coordinator
bullets: Coordinate procurement and deliveries for 6 housing projects at once, 140 flats in total.
Introduced a shared weekly plan for subcontractors and cut late deliveries by 30% in one year.
Prepare health and safety and maintenance documentation and lead handover meetings with clients.

experience.title: Procurement Assistant
bullets: Managed 40 regular suppliers on price, delivery time and complaints.
Built a Power BI report that gave management a weekly view of stock value.
